Consider the matrix $$ A = \left[\begin{array}{rrr} -2 \amp 1 \amp k \\ 2 \amp 3 \amp 0 \\ 1 \amp 2 \amp 2 \\ \end{array}\right] $$ where $k$ is a parameter.

Find an expression for $\det(A)$ in terms of the parameter $k$.

Use your expression for $\det(A)$ to determine the values of $k$ for which the vectors $$ \threevec{-2}{2}{1}, \threevec{1}{3}{2}, \threevec{k}{0}{2} $$ are linearly independent.
